## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run GLM-4 9B Chat 1M (Q4_K_M, needs ~6.3 GB, from [huggingface.co/bartowski](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/glm-4-9b-chat-1m-GGUF/tree/f50cedd62a26b910d71feda1e021f88716d28b58))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf bartowski/glm-4-9b-chat-1m-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf bartowski/glm-4-9b-chat-1m-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (~10.1 GB) `llama cli -hf bartowski/glm-4-9b-chat-1m-GGUF:Q8_0`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run GLM-4 9B Chat 1M (Q4_K_M, needs ~6.3 GB, from [huggingface.co/bartowski](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/glm-4-9b-chat-1m-GGUF/tree/f50cedd62a26b910d71feda1e021f88716d28b58))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/bartowski/glm-4-9b-chat-1m-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: Q8_0 (~10.1 GB) `lms get https://huggingface.co/bartowski/glm-4-9b-chat-1m-GGUF@Q8_0 -y`

### Ollama

1. Install Ollama. [Download it (macOS / Windows)](https://ollama.com/download)
   
   ```sh
   # Linux
   curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
   ```

2. Run GLM-4 9B Chat 1M (Q4_K_M, needs ~6.3 GB, from [huggingface.co/bartowski](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/glm-4-9b-chat-1m-GGUF/tree/f50cedd62a26b910d71feda1e021f88716d28b58))
   
   ```sh
   ollama run hf.co/bartowski/glm-4-9b-chat-1m-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (~10.1 GB) `ollama run hf.co/bartowski/glm-4-9b-chat-1m-GGUF:Q8_0`

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (BF16, needs ~18.97 GB, from [huggingface.co/zai-org](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/glm-4-9b-chat-1m/tree/f8579ac096986e44ba24a5060d2fb79bedb56ef3))
   
   ```sh
   uv run --with torch --with 'transformers<5' --with accelerate python -c "from transformers import pipeline; print(pipeline('text-generation', model='zai-org/glm-4-9b-chat-1m', torch_dtype='auto', device_map='auto', trust_remote_code=True)('Once upon a time', max_new_tokens=40)[0]['generated_text'])"
   ```

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/zai-org](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/glm-4-9b-chat-1m)
